## Why this is still a draft

Keep the original model-owner and FinalUse paths reviewable while pairing the actual Chain pressure experiment to exact source and merge objects. Current paired service, PQ authorization and independent model efficacy are not accepted.

## Changes

- Use the existing reviewed caller boundaries and typed current-registry view without broadening installation or model authority.
- Retain the exact Chain pair: head **131f673d9563e72aca7139f3239856957d118d49**, actual merge **66634191298767b40691d6b2a298418ec19e3673**, base **57c1ed545d067937cbd7aaa7570d5f22123265e6**.
- Replace the unsigned height comparison with the equivalent zero check; None/zero/positive semantics are unchanged.
- Apply the hosted two-file Ruff format correction. Both Python ASTs are identical before and after, excluding source locations.
- Preserve the original export manifest's old source identity; do not relabel old model measurements as this head's result.

## Validation

No local Hepta Rust/Cargo/Bazel build, test, fmt or fix was run. Static caller validation covers 45 boundaries / 5,268 Rust files with authorityGranted=false. B4 17/17 and typed-view 10/10 Python controls pass on the reviewed source. Frozen Ruff 0.15.13 checks all 188 files after the two-file correction. Original offline-cache and hosted failures remain retained.

Final published head **f5c1a5ddb05498df09195db2f814320423f765a6**, tree **2eb92c9313add421b4fb4ae2a6db503df97991d0**, equals locally qualified **b860eda29f5e74828faa0dde0ba64d98342a8106**. Actual merge **c9d84de601e2959ea23d93cac5ffcc9a1d7344f5** has verified ordered parents and computed tree equality. This tree identity does not confer old native runtime acceptance.

## Original results remain blocking

At original f50ea5dd / Chain131f pair run **40621740076**, the four Linux lanes each pass their five named tests but all fail the confirmation reader. Baseline confirmations 4/4; pressure 0/4. Pressure Submit 28/28 timely, Head 77/80, History 9/11. Attack calls 1,031 = 967 refused + 64 errors, all 64 errors late. Real paid depletion 0/8 sustained phases. Two Windows lanes pass; four Linux lanes fail. Every failure and the actual original tuple are retained.

The original real-model cohort at Hepta50f4fe / Chain73ffdd has baseline 16/32 and candidate 16/32, with all choices unchanged and Ineligible/no-update. Repetitions of the same 32 queries are not 64 independent tasks. Offline-publisher retrieval is real; production installation, independent future-task efficacy and multi-administrator WAN remain unaccepted. Later small exports preserve those original bytes; they are not a new model score.

Five dependency advisories remain open. No advisory ignore, gate reduction, local native workaround, default activation or main merge is included. **HOLD / NO_GO.**
